messages:
miriam: Heads up — helm upgrade of gpupool-chart v2.4.1 in us-west-2 stuck in a pre-upgrade 'quiesce' hook. Argocd sync is blocked and release is stalled. 

devon: Can you paste the helm / argocd logs so we can see which hook step failed?

miriam: Paste from argocd: 
```
pre-sync hook job/quiesce-gpupool failed: Job has failed: BackoffLimitExceeded
kubectl describe job quiesce-gpupool-2026-03-18 shows: DeletionTimestamp: 2026-03-18T10:32:11Z
Finalizers: [gpupool.finalizers.redwood.ai]
```

sanjay: That finalizer is from the gpupool operator. Looks like the operator pod got evicted during a node drain and didn’t finish cleaning up, so the CRD instance is stuck with a finalizer. Operator is currently CrashLoopBackOff on a GPU node.

kyle: Also seeing drift in infra: terraform state says nodepool desired_size=6 but cloud autoscaler reports 4 active nodes. TF apply hasn't been kicked because the CI pipeline blocked on the argocd sync job. Circle of doom.

tara: Cost heads-up: if we failover the batch jobs to us-east to get capacity, estimated extra spend for this week is ~$7k (reserved bursts + egress). Finance needs a heads-up before we flip regions.

ops-bot: [argocd-bot] sync status: Application gpupool-service blocked — pre-sync hook job/quiesce-gpupool failed. https://argocd.internal/app/gpupool :warning:

devon: Quick mitigation options: 1) restart operator to trigger reconciliation, 2) manually remove the finalizer from the CRD (fast but risky), 3) restore operator secret if the operator is failing due to KMS/secret issues. Prefer (1) or (3).

miriam: Tried restarting operator pod — it fails to come up cleanly: logs: 
```
panic: failed to unwrap secrets: kms: key ring not found
at controller/secret.go:58
```
Looks like the KMS key used for secret rotation was rotated yesterday.

sanjay: If operator can't decrypt the storage secret it won't remove finalizers. Plan: restore the previous KMS-wrapped secret from backups, scale operator to 0 then 1 to force requeue, re-run argocd sync. If that doesn't work, manual finalizer removal with careful notes.

kyle: I'll open a quick tf PR to align nodepool desired_size with observed capacity after we unblock argocd, so the autoscaler doesn't bounce. Putting it as hotfix in infra repo.

tara: I've pinged billing for one-off approval to cover failover costs if we must move workloads to us-east. Also flagged a finance review if this repeats.

miriam: Restoring KMS-wrapped secret from backup now. If this finishes operator should start and reconcile finalizers. :eyes:

(12 minutes later)

miriam: Operator restarted and successfully unwrapped secrets. It reconciled the gpupool CR, removed the finalizer, job/quiesce finished, argocd sync resumed. Helm upgrade completed; canary pod passed readiness. Leaving the cluster in normal state now. :tada:

devon: Nice recovery. Post-action items: add a preflight check in release pipeline to verify operator health + KMS unwrap before running helm hooks, and add a quiesce hook timeout to auto-rollback if blocked for >10m.

sanjay: Agree. Also add a small automation to detect nodepool TF drift and block cross-region failover unless approved.

miriam: Created tracking issue INFRA-1345 with runbook and pipeline gate links: https://redwood.internal/issues/INFRA-1345 — will follow up with a PR for the preflight checks.

(thread closed)
